extension.procedure:
Corpus extension (PI design addition 2026-11-04 15:3x UTC, decided blind; see DEVIATIONS.md).

Population: SWE-bench full test split (princeton-nlp/SWE-bench, revision recorded in tasks.json), non-Verified instances
of the same permissively licensed repositories (matplotlib and pylint excluded), whose official instance image
docker.io/swebench/sweb.eval.x86_64.<repo>_1776_<id> exists (checked by manifest HEAD: scripts/check_ext_images.py).
Order: random and stratified by repository, seed 20261104: within each repository the sorted ids are shuffled with
random.Random(20261104) (repositories in sorted order, one rng); the k-th task of repository r (n_r tasks) gets the
position (k + u_r) / n_r with u_r ~ U[0,1) drawn from the same rng, and all tasks are sorted by position (ties by a
further uniform draw). Every prefix of the order is therefore close to proportional by repository.
One S1 episode per task, split "swebench_test_ext", appended after the 500 planned Verified jobs (split "verified").
Writes configs/ext_order.json, configs/ext_images.json, configs/run_order_v2.json and updates data/pnc/tasks.json.

privacy.rule: an e-mail address is <local> '@' <domain> in a decoded string value (Unicode-aware, RFC 5321/6531): <local> = a word character (any script, digit or '_') followed by word characters, combining marks and '.', '%', '+', '-', or an RFC 2047 encoded word (=?charset?B|Q?...?=); '@' may also be percent-encoded ('%40'); <domain> = one or more DNS labels (letters/digits of any script, inner '-') and an alphabetic TLD of 2+ letters, not followed by a letter, digit or combining mark. Escape letters directly after a backslash (\n, \t, \uXXXX, ... inside nested JSON or repr strings) are not part of <local>. Addresses in mailto: links and in URL user-info are matched the same way. Every match is replaced by the placeholder, whether the domain is personal, institutional, a project domain or a test/documentation domain (conservative: no allow-list).
privacy.excluded: Python decorator / attribute chains are never changed: a match whose domain starts with a module or object used as decorator (pytest., functools., register., click., typing., enum., contextlib., unittest., dataclasses., decorator., cython., staticmethod., classmethod., override_settings.), with one of the dotted prefixes admin.register/display/action, mark.<pytest mark>, u.quantity, app/parent/child/bp/blueprint.route, mock.patch, or of the form <CamelCase>.register; '@' at the start of a line or after whitespace (a decorator) never matches because a local part is required.
privacy.scope: every string value of every record in every JSON/JSONL file (messages, reasoning, tool-call arguments (JSON strings, still valid JSON), tool results, raw texts, patches). Unchanged: dict keys, id and hash fields (keys 'id', '*_id', '*sha*', '*md5*', '*digest*', '*hash*', base_commit, head, image), and the test identifiers in grading.jsonl 'tests' (SWE-bench test node ids; their only matches are synthetic URL credentials of the psf/requests test suite on example.com, complex.url.com, some.host, other.host, request.com).
privacy.stale_fields: fields measured on the original, unmasked text are kept as recorded: prompt_tokens, masking.rendered_tokens, response.usage, proxy.prompt_sha, tool_results[].output_bytes; grading.jsonl graded the original final patches (episode_meta 'patch' is masked where it held an address). Record counts, ids, order and all non-text fields are identical to v1.
privacy.byte_offsets: contexts.jsonl: every changed line is right-padded with spaces (JSON whitespace, before the newline) to its original byte length, so the file size and every line's byte offset equal v1 and the byte offsets ('off') in TranscriptLab's state metadata (experiments/contagion/data/confirmatory/meta_S1.jsonl) stay valid. Other files are not padded.
